value.body: Week 1 covered shifts 1-5. The robot cabled 5 racks and 450 connections. First-pass success was 96.0%: 259 of 270 copper and 173 of 180 fiber. There were 17 interventions, or 3.8 per 100 connections. 1 miss was customer-caused. We recorded 1 live disturbance and 3 safety stops. The gate result was 0 go, 1 partial and 4 no-go shifts. 3 shifts carried a blocking note. The go streak at week end is 0, and the gate needs 10 consecutive go shifts before unsupervised work. The robot stays supervised next week because that streak requirement has not been met.
value.subject: Robot cabling pilot, week 1 (shifts 1-5): supervised next week

The robot will therefore keep working supervised next week.
